description: A child's bedroom photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing a three-quarter corner view of the bed area and nightstand. The walls are a saturated coral-salmon pink, lively and warm. A gallery wall arrangement of colorful prints hangs above and to the left of the headboard: a green tropical leaf poster, a travel photograph, a daisy illustration, a motivational card reading "see good in all things," and a pastel yellow postcard. The bed's upholstered headboard is rounded in soft ivory with green piping, and the bedding is a riot of saturated pattern — a pink gingham duvet, a blue ruffled pillow, a yellow pillow, and a multicolor confetti-dot blanket. The white painted nightstand with a round drawer pull sits at the left. Atop its surface, a playful sculptural object in cobalt blue with two glowing warm globes at different heights sits in the center; the glowing orbs emit a soft warm incandescent light that spreads at surface level around the nightstand. Adjacent objects include a miniature pink cloud decoration, a retro ice cream cone ornament, and a small yellow disc-shaped container. The mood is playful, saturated, and joyful. Color palette is saturated color — pink dominant — with cobalt and mustard.
